content.comment_body: Hello, I need assistance resolving an issue with the [product_name] add-in. I'm using the newest version of Microsoft Excel together with [product_name] and, despite following the steps in the [document], the add-in does not show up in Excel and I cannot login since it's not visible in the add-ins section. Help with configuring Office properly would be appreciated. Thank you.

I'm not sure about the current Microsoft Office version. In my experience with older Office versions, the add-in would appear under the 'Add-Ins' tab in the menu bar when selected, and [product_name] would be listed there.

Hello [user_name], Microsoft added additional security features in July 2016. Depending on your computer's configuration and where your files are saved, you may need to unblock downloaded files before using them. Right-click the relevant XLAM file, select Properties > General, check the Unblock option, and then click OK. Afterwards, start Excel and use File > Open to load the add-in file. If this still doesn't work, try adding your add-ins folder to the 'Trusted Locations' within Excel's Trust Center. Copy the folder path, then navigate to: File > Options > Trust Center > Trusted Locations > Add new location, paste the path, and confirm. Restart Excel, and you should then see the add-in tab.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering problems with the [product_name] add-in in the latest Microsoft Excel version, especially when used with [product_name]. Despite following the instructions provided, the add-in does not show up in Excel, preventing login and further usage. It's suggested that recent Office security measures may block the add-in, unlike previous versions.
